英文输入法下默认接收6位数字或字母输入。.en-us: By default, accepts six digits or letters using an English input method.

设置参数`length`控制单体输入框的数量。.en-us: Use `length` to set the number of individual input boxes.

设置参数`size`控制尺寸规格。.en-us: Use `size` to control the component size.

设置参数`variant`控制形态变体风格。.en-us: Use `variant` to choose the component variant.

设置参数`disabled`控制是否禁用当前组件。.en-us: Use `disabled` to control whether the component is disabled.

设置参数`status`控制强制校验状态渲染。.en-us: Use `status` to force a validation status.

设置参数`mask`自定义遮罩显示字符。.en-us: Use `mask` to customize the masking character.

**AntdOTP**的属性`value`将在全部输入框均输入完毕的情况下触发更.en-us: The **AntdOTP** `value` updates only after all input boxes have been filled.
